task_name: World 111 Task B  -  Cash-Basis BI Tool (Muse) to Accrual GAAP Bridge & 21-Month PO Conservation Proof

rubric.description: Reconciles Muse cash revenue ($47,012,519.65) less Shopify sales tax collected ($2,403,261.26) plus gateway fee gross-up and cutoff ($701,466.93) to GAAP Net Revenue of $45,310,725.32 ($0.00 unreconciled delta).

Reconciles Muse cash OpEx ($33,382,972.66) less Avalara sales tax liability remittances ($2,201,711.96) and working-capital card/payroll timing ($2,523,352.30) to GAAP Recurring OpEx of $28,657,908.40 ($0.00 unreconciled delta).

Proves 21-month factory PO cash-to-SKU conservation: $17,088,275.57 incurred factory purchases vs $16,834,890.20 accounted for ($13,182,818.70 shipped COGS + $3,652,071.50 inventory build), a 98.52% match with $253,385.37 (1.48%) normal shrinkage.
Explains that customer sales tax collected and remitted via Avalara is a Balance Sheet fiduciary pass-through (2150 Sales Tax Payable) and never P&L revenue or OpEx.

prompt: Using `collars_yoy_comparability_and_muse_bridge_2026_Q3.xlsx`, reconcile the Muse cash-basis BI revenue and operating expense figures to GAAP accrual Net Revenue and Recurring OpEx, and perform a 21-month factory PO cash-to-SKU conservation audit.
gold_output:
World 111 Task B  -  Cash-Basis BI Tool (Muse) to Accrual GAAP Bridge & 21-Month PO Conservation Proof:
1. Revenue Bridge (R47): Muse cash revenue of $47,012,519.65 less Shopify sales tax collected of $2,403,261.26 plus gateway fee gross-up and cutoff of $701,466.93 equals GAAP Net Revenue of $45,310,725.32 ($0.00 unreconciled delta).
2. OpEx Bridge (R47): Muse cash OpEx of $33,382,972.66 less Avalara sales tax liability remittances of $2,201,711.96 (fiduciary pass-through to 2150 Sales Tax Payable, never P&L revenue or OpEx) and working-capital card/payroll timing of $2,523,352.30 equals GAAP Recurring OpEx of $28,657,908.40 ($0.00 unreconciled delta).
3. 21-Month PO Cash Conservation (R46): Incurred factory purchases of $17,088,275.57 vs $16,834,890.20 accounted for ($13,182,818.70 shipped COGS + $3,652,071.50 inventory build) proves a 98.52% match with $253,385.37 (1.48%) normal shrinkage.
